Novak Djokovic vs Dominic Thiem - Semi-Final Highlights | Roland-Garros 2019. Watch the best moments from the semi-final that opposed Novak Djokovic and Dominic Thiem at 2019. Dominic Thiem won 6/2; 3/6; 7/5; 5/7; 7/5.
This is the official YouTube Channel of Roland Garros, home of the French Open. The tournament 2019 will run from 20 May - 09 June.
